subject.title: [Bug]: Slack reaction_added/reaction_removed events never delivered via Socket Mode (multi-account, v2026.3.24)

question: What live Slack evidence should be required before this reaction-specific Socket Mode issue is closed, duplicated, or sent to a fix PR?
rationale: Source inspection proves handler support and plausible drop boundaries, but it cannot identify whether the live failure is Slack/Bolt non-delivery, account filtering, authorization, or the broader Socket Mode liveness class.

options.title: Require reaction-specific live proof
options.body: Keep this issue open until a maintainer or reporter adds redacted current-main Socket Mode reaction envelopes, trace logs, and status output that identify the first failing boundary.

options.title: Fold into the broader Socket Mode issue
options.body: Close or duplicate this only if maintainers accept the broader Slack Socket Mode delivery report as canonical despite its missing reaction-specific diagnostics.

options.title: Sponsor a maintainer live repro
options.body: Run a controlled multi-account Slack Socket Mode test and decide fix, duplicate, or close based on observed current-main behavior.

recommendation.title: Require reaction-specific live proof
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open until a maintainer or reporter adds redacted current-main Socket Mode reaction envelopes, trace logs, and status output that identify the first failing boundary.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest history signal is around Slack Socket Mode filtering and system-event ingress boundaries, where this proof decision will land.
